verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Appwrite as an MCP SERVER (exposing its own API/docs for LLMs to call, docs-11, probe-3, docs-35), which is the opposite of the story — the user wants to plug external MCP servers into Appwrite so Appwrite itself can consume their tools. No evidence shows Appwrite acting as an MCP client or supporting external tool integrations via plugged-in MCP servers.
